info.title: API.SH: Alibaba
info.description: The Alibaba API from API.SH: public Alibaba data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One alibaba.com product by link or id: title, category and breadcrumbs, price range and quantity price tiers, minimum order, units sold, images and videos, options (size, color...) and SKUs with prices, key and full attributes, sample price, customization options, lead time by quantity, package size and weight, where it ships from, Trade Assurance, the store rating, and the supplier (name, store and profile links, country, years on Alibaba, business type, verified and Gold supplier marks, response time, on-time delivery, orders and revenue in the last 6 months, rating with its breakdown by service, shipping and quality, about the company). 404 for a removed product.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/alibaba-product

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An alibaba.com/product-detail/..._<id>.html link (with or without https://), or the product id, e.g. `1601207586306` (the `id` of an Alibaba search result).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Buyer reviews of an Alibaba.com supplier, one entry per reviewed order, 20 a page: masked buyer name, country, date, the order's supplier-service and shipping-time scores, and every product reviewed in it (product id, name, link, image, quality score, text, photos and videos, likes, and the supplier's reply). Also the overall rating and number of rated orders, each category's average and star breakdown, and the photo/video filter counts. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/alibaba-reviews

parameters.name: supplier
parameters.description: Store name, the part before .en.alibaba.com (or any store link).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Any link on the supplier's store.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Only reviews with photos or with videos.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Wholesale products for a search on Alibaba.com, 48 per page: title, images, price range and quantity price tiers, minimum order, units sold, category, certifications, and the supplier (name, country, years, verification, response rate and time, transactions, trade assurance) with its review scores. Filter by supplier country, price range, maximum minimum-order quantity, category and Verified Pro suppliers; sort by best match, most sold or response rate. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page (up to 100 pages). Each product also has ready_to_ship, promotion_tags and delivery_estimate (e.g. Delivery by Dec 02, when shown). Filter with ready_to_ship=true (products marked Ready to Ship) and verified_supplier=true (assessed suppliers).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/alibaba-search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-100). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Supplier country, two-letter code (e.g. CN, VN, IN).

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Minimum unit price in USD.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Maximum unit price in USD.

parameters.name: max_moq
parameters.description: Only products whose minimum order quantity is at most this.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Alibaba category id (the `category.id` of a product, e.g. 380230 for phone cases).

parameters.name: verified_pro
parameters.description: true: only Verified Pro suppliers.

parameters.name: ready_to_ship
parameters.description: true: only products marked Ready to Ship.

parameters.name: verified_supplier
parameters.description: true: only products from assessed (verified) suppliers.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An Alibaba supplier's profile: company name, country and location, years on the platform, verified and gold status, review rating and count, response rate and time, on-time dispatch and reorder rates, online revenue, main categories, product groups, and the company's capability details (employees, floor space, production lines, R&D engineers, QC inspectors, customization, trade terms, featured services). Give the store name, its link, or search words.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/alibaba-supplier

parameters.name: supplier
parameters.description: The supplier's store name: the part before .en.alibaba.com in its store link.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The supplier's store link (https://<name>.en.alibaba.com/).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words; the supplier of the first matching product is returned (use instead of supplier or url).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A supplier's own catalog on Alibaba.com, 16 a page: product id, title, link, price text and range, unit, minimum order, orders, units sold in 180 days, review score, ready-to-ship and free-shipping flags, certifications, product group, video flag and images; plus the catalog total, the ready-to-ship total and the store's product groups (id, name, link, sub-groups). List the whole catalog, one product group (`group`, or a group link in `url`) or a keyword search inside the store (`q`). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/alibaba-supplier-products

parameters.name: supplier
parameters.description: Store name, the part before .en.alibaba.com (or any store link).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Any link on the supplier's store, e.g. https://ledbuilders.en.alibaba.com/productlist.html or a product group page.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Product group id (from `groups`).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords to search inside the store.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default newest).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
